Khaleda trying to make Liberation War controversial
2014-03-31T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent, Ctg
https://www.thedailystar.net/khaleda-trying-to-make-liberation-war-controversial-18025

BNP chief Khaleda Zia is trying to make Liberation War controversial and protect war criminals by disseminating bizarre and false information, said Information Minister Hasanul Haq Inu yesterday. He was addressing as chief guest the biannual convention of Chittagong Union of Journalists at Chittagong Press Club. Inu made the comment as Khaleda recently claimed late president Ziaur Rahman, founder of BNP, was the first president of independent Bangladesh as he proclaimed the country's independence.
